title: By Design
summary: Men and women, as God intended. A five-week series on marriage, manhood, womanhood, sex, and the questions the church usually avoids, with every message, classes and groups, conversations, books, and counseling referrals.
seo_description: By Design: a five-week series from Christ Community Church on what the Bible says about marriage, manhood, womanhood, sex, gender, and sexuality. Watch every message and find classes, books, and counseling.

blocks.text:
Something is off. Men are asking what they're for. Women are told their value is in everything but who God made them to be. And the culture keeps offering new answers that leave everyone more confused.

Scripture tells a better story. Men and women were made different, made equal, and made for each other, on purpose.

In this five-week series, Minister Mark Ashton opens up what the Bible actually says about marriage, manhood, womanhood, sex, and the questions the church usually avoids: gender identity, sexuality, and what it means that God made you the way he did.

No topic off the table. Every message grounded in Scripture. The final week answers questions sent in by the congregation.

blocks.text:
Marriage By Design

Minister Mark Ashton explores Ephesians 5:21–33 and God’s design for marriage, focusing on mutual submission, sacrificial love, serving your spouse, and staying on the same team.

Men By Design

Biblical manhood, the danger of passivity, and the responsibility men have to protect what God has entrusted to them. Where the first Adam failed, the Second Adam remained faithful.

Women By Design

Chaka Heinze explores God’s purposeful design for women through Genesis and the life of Jesus, from being created in the image of God to serving as ezer kenegdo.

Sex By Design

God’s design for sex, intimacy, and marriage from Genesis 2, 1 Corinthians 7, and Song of Songs, plus the real challenges couples face, including mismatched desire, pornography, shame, purity culture, and past trauma.

Questions By Design

Minister Mark answers real questions about marriage, desire, lust, pornography, homosexuality, gender identity, intersex people, asexuality, divorce, and remarriage.
